description: This file defines the configuration class for the SystemCheck plugin in the OrangeHRM project. It implements plugin and console configuration interfaces, providing methods to initialize with a request and register console commands, specifically adding a toggle command for the system check screen.

classes.name: SystemCheckPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the SystemCheck plugin, implementing plugin and console configuration interfaces, enabling initialization and command registration.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration with a Request object. Currently does nothing.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers console commands, adding ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand to the console.
